mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as higher borrowing costs dampen corporate investment and consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between UNRATE increases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate lower corporate earnings.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in periods of declining RSAFS are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% within a month signals supply-side disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to potential inflationary pressures and reduced output.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between INDPRO drops and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate increased consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint effect of HOUST and UNRATE changes on SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with a rise in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals inflationary pressures despite easing monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate stagflation.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint effect of FEDFUNDS decreases and CPIAUCSL increases on SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate increased consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of increasing PAYEMS are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% within a quarter signals robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate increased corporate earnings and consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between GDPC1 increases and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
